rows.text: “We are raising our full-year 2026 outlook to reflect our strong third quarter results and improved expectations for the fourth quarter,” said Peter Walker. “At the midpoint, our updated guidance calls for full-year revenue of $5.35 billion and adjusted net income per diluted share of $28.00, representing growth of 18% and 31%, respectively.”
“For the fourth quarter, we expect revenue of approximately $1.37 billion and adjusted net income per diluted share of $7.65 at the midpoint,” concluded Walker.

“Revenue for the third quarter of 2026 is expected to be approximately $1.355 billion at the midpoint, growing 16% year over year, and adjusted net income per diluted share is expected to be $7.15 at the midpoint, growing 26% year over year,” said Peter Walker.
